Subject: Offsite logistics: concierge liaison, keycards, and room-block reconciliation

Hi Marta / Conference Ops,

Thanks again for holding the block for our Redwood exec offsite (May 22-24). A few coordination items we need to lock down so our travel ops team can finalize communications: 

- Room block: 42 rooms (15 king suites, 25 doubles, 2 ADA king). Check-in: May 22 after 3pm. Check-out: May 24 by 11am.
- Arrival windows: most arrivals between 10:00–15:00 on May 22; a handful of late arrivals after 20:00.
- Keycards: we'd like to pre-program keycards by last name for check-in efficiency (two keycards per room). Please confirm if you can pre-program and what lead time you need.
- Concierge liaison: we need a single on-site point person to meet incoming groups, handle dietary substitutions for the May 23 working lunch, and coordinate shuttles to the offsite venue.
- Master bill: Redwood will cover meeting room charges and the master incidental folio for rooms on the master account. We need an invoice that breaks out per-night room rate, taxes, and any early check-in fees; please confirm your process for final reconciliation.
- Dietary/shuttle: attaching our draft rooming list that includes dietary flags and arrival times. We expect ~6 vegetarian, 3 gluten-free, 4 pescatarian, and 2 severe nut allergies. Shuttle runs: 09:00 and 09:30 on May 23 from hotel to venue (approx 12 miles).

Can you confirm the concierge name, the keycard pre-program timeline, and upload a tentative block summary so we can reconcile rates internally? If you need a CC authorization form for the master bill, send it over and I'll route to Finance.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Director, Events & Executive Programs
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Hi Lauren,

Appreciate the detail — makes our job easier. Quick responses inline: 

- Keycards: yes, we can pre-program two keycards per room keyed to last name/room number. We typically need final rooming at least 48 hours before arrival (by May 20) to guarantee programmed keys for early check-ins.
- Concierge liaison: assigning Sofia Mendez (sofia.m@garrisonhotel.com). She will be your on-site contact for arrivals, dietary substitutions, and shuttle manifests. Sofia's profile attached.
- Shuttle: we can operate the 09:00 and 09:30 runs. We'll provide a 56-passenger coach (one per run) and a 20-passenger van for late additions.
- Early check-in: rooms requested before 3pm are subject to availability; we offer an early check-in fee of $30 per room or we can guarantee at $45 per room if you want blocks held for 11am access.
- Master bill: we can issue a provisional block summary and a DocuSign invoice for the master account. Final reconciliation will reflect actual room nights and incidentals.

Attached: Garrison_block_summary_20270502.xlsx (contains provisional rates: King Suite $320/night, Double $210/night, ADA King $320/night, tax and service fees).

If you want me to hold the guaranteed early check-in rate, let me know and I'll place it on the block.

Best,
Marta Cabana
Director of Sales & Events
The Garrison Hotel & Conference Center
phone: (206) 555-2093

For the working lunch on May 23 we need boxed options for 5 attendees who will miss the plenary session.

2) Shuttle manifest: we'll finalize the manifest on May 20 but can you confirm the coach pick-up location at the hotel (valet lane or loading dock)? We prefer the valet lane for guest visibility.

3) Keycard distribution: will Sofia be able to distribute pre-programmed cards at a dedicated check-in desk? If yes, can we reserve two staff members to handle the 42 rooms between 2:30–4:30pm?

4) Early check-in: we're inclined to guarantee a small number (6 rooms) for 11am access for senior execs. Please confirm the hold fee and if that can be added to a provisional master block rather than billed per card.

Thanks — Ben will reconcile the rate math once we have the updated block file.
